name: MapScreen - Reattach
description: An agent worked this map and then left. The band does not pitch a first meeting at someone whose board already carries an agent's work - it demotes to the one-row reattach strip, keeping only the prompt naming this map and the MCP command. AgentHandoff owns that decision and its own scenarios show the strip alone; what only a screen-level frame can show is the strip sitting above a board with that work visible on it, which is the comparison that makes the demotion look right rather than arbitrary.
